name: reconciliation-statement
title: Draft reconciliation statement
for_each: select id,name from accounts order by name

sections.title: Account movement totals
sections.note: Review source completeness and opening balances separately. This is transaction reconciliation evidence, not bank balance certification.

sections.title: Outstanding transactions
sections.sql: select side,external_id,booked_on,reference,currency,amount_cents,match_status from transaction_status where account_id=$1 and match_status<>'approved' order by booked_on

sections.title: Import register
sections.sql: select side,source_name,row_count,total_cents,period_end,retain_until,sha256 from imports where account_id=$1 order by created_at

name: investigation-worksheet
title: Draft investigation worksheet
for_each: select id,title as name from cases order by due_on

sections.title: Investigation
sections.sql: select title,owner,due_on,status,resolution from cases where id=$1

sections.title: Source item
sections.sql: select t.account,t.side,t.external_id,t.booked_on,t.reference,t.currency,t.amount_cents,t.match_status from transaction_status t join cases c on c.transaction_id=t.id where c.id=$1

sections.title: Notes and decisions
sections.sql: select action,actor,detail,created_at from events where entity_id=$1 order by created_at

name: match-review
title: Draft match review record
for_each: select id,reason as name from matches where status<>'reversed' order by created_at

sections.title: Supporting transactions
sections.sql: select t.side,t.external_id,t.booked_on,t.reference,t.amount_cents from transactions t join match_members mm on mm.transaction_id=t.id where mm.match_id=$1 order by t.side,t.external_id
